_comment: THE INLINE OBJECT text contract (task-85fee859cf3bfef6), as ONE file read by every engine that renders an inline object without a registered renderer: api/test/barkpark/portable_doc/render/inline_object_parity_test.exs, js/packages/react/tests/inline-object.parity.test.ts, internal/pdrender/inline_object_parity_test.go. An inline object is a childless inline node {type: , ...fields} whose type has no built-in renderer (a schema's blocks.inline type, e.g. Sanity's chip or mention). Law: its text is the first NON-EMPTY string among the keys text, title, label, name, value, in that order; a non-string value is skipped. Elixir and React render text (both escaped), an EMPTY span when the text is empty, so the node is never dropped silently. The Go TUI shows the text, or [type] when it is empty. Hand-authored; regenerate nothing.

cases.name: text wins (post-11's Sanity chip, built-in chip excluded)
title when there is no text
no text-carrying key: an empty marked span
markup in the text is escaped, not interpreted
